ShortDescription.Value: Read-only performance monitoring with optional experimental city-loading budget tuning. No visual-quality changes.

Publish.LongDescription:
BETA — performance monitoring, not a guaranteed FPS boost.
WHAT IT DOES Samples FPS and available frame-time/draw counters. Main-thread time includes waits and rendering work; these readings do not prove that simulation is the bottleneck.
HOW TO USE Open FT on the top-left toolbar. Options → FastTrack controls monitoring and logging. Pause persists until you enable it again.
CURRENT LIMITATIONS FastTrack does not lower LOD, shadows, render scale, terrain, effects or culling. It does not speed up simulation. Experimental loading boost is OFF by default and only adjusts upload budgets during city loading; a speedup is not guaranteed. Leave it off when investigating GPU problems. Unsupported profiler counters show as unavailable. Extended in-game regression testing is still pending.
Publish.ChangeLog:
1.3.5-beta.1 — Maintenance beta
Fixed persistent Pause and repeated restore writes. Corrected settings registration, unavailable-counter handling and misleading telemetry labels. Loading-budget tuning is now an explicit opt-in experiment.
Build/offline checks do not establish full in-game verification.
